name: Ikara Ryouko
source:
Newscaster for a well-known TV station. Recently, she married a young actor and caused a sensation all over the news.
In reality, there is no affection between them, as both parties have their own agendas to gain popularity. 

She is involved behind the scenes with the principal of the school who is also powerful authority in the world of politics, and ensures that no damaging information gets leaked to the media.

She plans to rise to a higher position and she will not hesitate to use her own body as a weapon. 

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=213461&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
